CA.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3) is explicitly bound to an origin/process estimate, linking content and processing condition.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates and an explicit origin/status are present for the same referent, and the data show organized placement (red/blue sets).

A.rationale: Processing/origin label ('history_estimate'/'feedback_through') is explicitly tied to the same content coordinates.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets are present.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from coordinate lists, distinguishing content identity from status/process information.

O.rationale: Large explicit coordinate sets and the labeled current/candidate node structure describe how contents are organized/presented.
